content.title: 天气微仪式｜听觉准备、触雨确认与食物收束
content.summary: 固定同一成年人物与雨棚边界，用帽檐、耳机、伸手接雨和一次咬食组成由听觉到触觉再到味觉的微仪式；镜头只在关键接触后收近。

quick_start.input_format: 成年人物＋天气边界＋听觉准备＋触觉与味觉收束
quick_start.recommended_input: 成年果园工人、木棚、雨幕、有线耳机、红李子。
required_anchors: 同一人物与屋檐边界持续
先听觉准备再伸手接雨
只以一次咬食完成微仪式
usage_steps: 把示例主体、场景和表层元素替换为原创概念。
让每个必需锚点和 Creative DNA 不可变条件都能在画面因果链中被看见。
选择 MiniMax H3 或 Seedance 2.0 模板，只填写已声明的可替换项。
生成前检查时长、事件顺序、镜头连续性、声音和反复制约束。
applicable_scope: 固定同一成年人物与雨棚边界，用帽檐、耳机、伸手接雨和一次咬食组成由听觉到触觉再到味觉的微仪式；镜头只在关键接触后收近。
能够保留全部必需锚点的原创 4–15 秒短片。
需要可复用因果视频结构的 MiniMax H3 或 Seedance 2.0 项目。
not_suitable_for: 要求复制来源人物、场景、道具、对白或镜头顺序的任务。
无法在目标时长内展示全部必需锚点的概念。
缺少紧凑因果链的长篇讲解或无关多地点叙事。

creative_dna.mechanism: 固定同一成年人物与雨棚边界，用帽檐、耳机、伸手接雨和一次咬食组成由听觉到触觉再到味觉的微仪式；镜头只在关键接触后收近。 The reusable mechanism preserves causal order, spatial anchors and the final proof while replacing every source-specific person, location, object, wording, choreography and design.

invariants.rule: One clearly adult subject and shelter boundary persist.
invariants.purpose: Establishes the baseline identity, object or geography that every later state must preserve.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact baseline rule, later changes cannot be attributed to the same subject, object or place, so the sequence loses its reference state. Removed rule: "One clearly adult subject and shelter boundary persist."

invariants.purpose: Makes the visible trigger precede and explain the first mechanism response.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact trigger rule, the response appears spontaneously and the central cause-and-effect claim is no longer demonstrated. Removed rule: "Listening preparation precedes weather contact."

invariants.rule: The palm visibly crosses from dry to wet space.
invariants.purpose: Keeps the middle progression registered instead of allowing an unexplained reset.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact progression rule, the middle can jump to a replacement state and the accumulated result is no longer traceable. Removed rule: "The palm visibly crosses from dry to wet space."

invariants.rule: Food identity remains stable before and after one bite.
invariants.purpose: Reconnects the changed or partial state to the established subject and spatial anchor.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact reconnection rule, detail or transformed shots can belong to a different subject or geography and continuity cannot be verified. Removed rule: "Food identity remains stable before and after one bite."

invariants.rule: Camera proximity follows tactile milestones rather than arbitrary cuts.
invariants.purpose: Turns the terminal hold into observable proof that the mechanism completed.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact terminal-proof rule, the sequence stops on motion alone and never confirms the promised outcome or preserved aftermath. Removed rule: "Camera proximity follows tactile milestones rather than arbitrary cuts."

slots.name: lead_subject
slots.constraint: An original stable subject or pair with a readable role.

slots.name: setting
slots.constraint: A new setting with fixed spatial anchors and no source-specific surface.

slots.name: escalation_variable
slots.constraint: One causal variable that changes through visible stages.

slots.name: performance_rule
slots.constraint: A restrained acting or motion rule that keeps the mechanism legible.

slots.name: camera_grammar
slots.constraint: An information order that proves each state without copying source shot boundaries.

slots.name: payoff
slots.constraint: A clean final physical, informational or social consequence.

slots.name: sound_family
slots.constraint: An original hierarchy of diegetic cues; no unsupported source-audio claim.

anti_copy_exclusions: all source faces, bodies, wardrobe, identities and creator-specific character designs
the source location, set dressing, props, products and exact environmental geometry
all source words, logos, watermarks, typefaces and brand identifiers
the source choreography, exact camera path, shot durations and transition timing
the source palette, signature effects, prompt wording, creator handle and narrative particulars
